messages:
zoe.partnerops: Heads-up team - coordinating a joint marketplace listing: Redwood connector for Snowflake DeltaShare -> Milvus (managed) + Databricks sample notebooks. Target announce: Tue Jun 9 10:00 PT. Im opening this thread to track owners and blockers. Reply with :white_check_mark: when you take an item.

omar.platform: I'll take the compatibility matrix and the sample notebook runner. Need the DeltaShare schema samples and the Milvus connection string for staging.

kevin.docs: I can do the docs + quickstart. Will need a short CLI snippet and a code example for Databricks (PySpark UDF).

kevin.docs: Proposed quickstart snippet:
```
# extract vectors from Snowflake DeltaShare and push to Milvus
redwood connector create --type deltashare --name sf-delta-1 \
  --source delta://account/db/schema/table \
  --sink milvus://staging-milvus:19530 \
  --options quantize=int8,batch=1000
```

sasha.marketing: I'll own the marketplace tile content and a launch email. Need 2 screenshots + a 1-line benefit statement. Also ask partners for co-marketing approval.

nina.legal: Legal - embargo request ok but need partner logo approvals from Snowflake and Milvus + Databricks. Send logos and statement by Fri 16:00 PT for review. No customer quotes until signed release forms.

infra-bot: Staging env created: staging-delta-milvus-2026-06-01 (owner: omar.platform). Credentials provisioned to partner-team SSO group.

omar.platform: For the notebook, I'll produce a Databricks notebook that shows DeltaShare SQL -> vectorize via our embeddings endpoint -> upsert to Milvus. Will post a Gist link when ready. Need confirmation on the embeddings model version to recommend.

zoe.partnerops: Recommend we call out two supported flows in the tile: 1) live-query-serving (serve vectors in-place from Delta via DeltaShare + proxy) and 2) batch-export to Milvus for lower-cost nearline workloads. That helps customers pick a path.

kevin.docs: Noted. I'll draft two short runbooks & a decision matrix. Omar, can you provide expected ingest throughput numbers for 50M vectors so we can include guidance?

omar.platform: Rough numbers on staging: single p3.8x ingest ~18k vec/s non-quantized, ~28k vec/s with int8. Query p95 ~35ms for 512-dim vectors. I'll run a 50M sample tonight and attach numbers.

qa-bot: Quick check: are we running integration tests with nested VARIANT columns in Delta tables? Known mapping issue flagged last quarter.

omar.platform: Good call - we will include flattening step in the sample notebook and add a small preflight script to normalize VARIANT->ARRAY fields. Will link the preflight script here.

zoe.partnerops: Action list (please ack):
- omar.platform: perf + notebook + preflight script (due Mon EOD)
- kevin.docs: quickstart + dual runbooks (due Tue AM)
- sasha.marketing: marketplace tile copy + screenshots (due Wed EOD)
- nina.legal: logo/embargo review (due Fri 16:00)

sasha.marketing: Acked for marketing items. I'll coordinate design for screenshots with #design.

kevin.docs: Draft quickstart done, pushing to docs branch and linking here: https://gist.github.com/redwood/delta-milvus-quickstart (WIP).

omar.platform: Perf run finished: 50M ingest, 4 shards, int8 quantize - ingest throughput 25k vec/s, p95 ingest 380ms, query p95 33ms. Artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/delta-milvus-50m-2026-06-02.tar.gz

zoe.partnerops: Nice. Sasha/kevin, can you pull console/dashboard screenshots and the notebook preview by Wed? Once Nina clears logos, we'll lock the announce time.

nina.legal: Received marketing assets for initial review. Noting a small trademark note from Milvus legal - they need their logo use to match brand guidelines. Please attach brand kit.

kevin.docs: Attached runbook snippets + decision matrix to the gist. Also added a sample Terraform role to grant DeltaShare read-only.

omar.platform: One blocker: Databricks samples need a small change for cluster init to install redwood-client wheel. I'll include a cluster-init cell.

zoe.partnerops: Thanks all. If no major blockers by Thu EOD, we'll confirm Tue Jun 9 announce and send partner invites next Mon. Keeping thread as canonical coordination channel. :rocket:
